rows.contradicts_prod_or_repo: The doc's literal ask was that EVERY financial posting batch calls events.log_event (the canonical 13-arg function). The actual repo does NOT do this uniformly: apps/backend/src/accounting/bank-recon/__tests__/coder-12-spine.test.ts explicitly documents that the bank-recon variance JE path writes audit.audit_events (via appendCrudAudit -> audit.append_event) and 'must NOT call events.log_event (its valid_subject_type CHECK rejects accounting subjects -> would roll back the posting)'. events.event_log's valid_subject_type allowlist (db/migrations/202606111050_w1a_event_log_spine.sql) only permits load/driver/unit/geofence/document/assignment/status/broker/task/alert — NOT accounting/journal/posting subjects. So the real, correct architecture is a DUAL mechanism: events.log_event for operational-domain spine events (dispatch-spine-emit.ts, banking-spine-emit.ts, maintenance-spine-emit.ts, driver-request-spine-emit.ts) and audit.audit_events for GL/accounting-specific postings, with accounting.transaction_source_links as the universal cross-reference table for both. This is a sound and arguably better design than the doc's literal ask, but it means CODER-12's original spec point ('every financial posting batch writes an events.log_event row') is technically false as written and should not be re-derived at face value by a future agent.
